scope_note: Registers only the event kinds implemented in physics build 0.1 (M2-M4 slices, phase 0). It reserves an extension mechanism for later phases without fabricating their kinds; S25 stays partial foundation work, not closed for all future phases.

identity_model.canonical_identity: utf8('name|role|kind_id|schema_version|lane_or_dash'); lane_or_dash is the lane after '/' or '-'
identity_model.stable_hash: fnv1a64 over the canonical identity string (sim.rng.fnv1a64)
identity_model.lane: the part after '/' distinguishes multiple producers sharing one kind; declared explicitly, never derived from container or call order
identity_model.sub_lane: engine RNG address lane (informational for identity; D0-04 replaces it with explicit draw addresses)
identity_model.attempt: attempt counters are reserved for D0-04 draw addressing and are not serialized in 0.1 or 0.2 logs

extension.registration_rule: a phase's freeze contract must add its kinds here before its first engine call site merges; unregistered kinds must not enter KIND_IDS or LOG_KIND_IDS
extension.s8_note: the boundary-driving kind (S8) stays unregistered until Phase 7 planning; reserving space is not implementing
extension.reserved_for_future_phases: none enumerated on purpose (S25: fabricating future kinds is forbidden)

legacy_0_1.encoding: log entry field 'kind' = fnv1a64(u16 kind id) & 0xFFFF, the truncated counter-based-stream hash
legacy_0_1.policy: The truncated hash remains the serialized identity in 0.1-legacy and 0.2 logs; stable_hash is a registry-side identity for future addressing (D0-04), not a claim that old logs contain registry IDs. Legacy 0.1 logs are verified only in the archived 0.1 source environment.
